# Systems and services router

Local routing instructions only; no target adapter, lab, credentials or runtime integration are supplied.

## Select the route

Identify the actual product/release, host or inventory boundary, service and requested outcome. A parent vendor alone is insufficient; distinguish vCenter control-plane inventory from guest OS/service work. Preserve the user's chosen use case and show coverage gaps for other products.

| Organisation/product | Local route |
| --- | --- |
| Broadcom vCenter/vSphere | [VMware systems](../system-broadcom-vmware/SKILL.md) |
| Canonical Ubuntu Server | [Ubuntu systems](../system-canonical-ubuntu/SKILL.md) |
| Microsoft Windows Server/Windows Admin Center/Hyper-V | [Windows systems](../system-microsoft-windows/SKILL.md) |
| Red Hat Enterprise Linux | [RHEL systems](../system-red-hat-rhel/SKILL.md) |
| SUSE Linux Enterprise Server/Multi-Linux Manager | [SUSE systems](../system-suse-sles/SKILL.md) |

## Workflow

1. Load the selected specialist and its version-matched official references; consult [upstream overlap](../../../docs/upstream-skill-register.md) and route detailed tasks to a configured applicable official task skill rather than copying its manual.
2. Check [official MCP scope](../../../docs/mcp-domains/systems-and-services.md). A configured documentation server can ground procedures but cannot inspect a host. Use actual advertised tools only when publisher, version and effective identity match; if unavailable, return source-backed guidance with the missing observations stated.
3. Separate observed service state, evidence gaps, hypotheses and application health. Permission failure is not evidence of an outage; service enablement is not current health.
4. Hand proposed effects to [admin-change-safety](../admin-change-safety/SKILL.md). Keep the exact host/service, impact, reviewed plan, recovery path and independent health checks together. Research does not authorise server installation, privilege changes or lifecycle actions.

For an initial evaluation, choose an authorised disposable target and synthetic application evidence. Report which evidence was actually collected and which remains a proposed test.
